text_block_list.text:
Ignoring the Trainer's attempts to stop 
her, Admire Vega kept running as if 
relentlessly driving herself into a 
corner. Before long, a sharp pain shot 
through her left leg...

According to the nightmares that haunted 
her before the Kikuka-sho, her legs should 
have shattered just like that. She felt 
that if it served as atonement, she would 
have accepted it.

However, none other than the younger 
sister herself—who finally appeared before 
Admire Vega—told her that there had never 
been anything to atone for from the very 
beginning.

"I was happy to be able to enjoy the race 
together with you." With a smile, her 
younger sister spoke those words, carrying 
the tragic fate that was meant to come, 
and vanished along with it.

Thanks to the Trainer's desperate calls, 
Admire Vega finally opened her eyes.

However, overwhelmed by the emptiness of 
feeling like half of her was missing, all 
she could do was cling to her Trainer in 
tears.
